title: How the Black-Jewish Alliance Broke Up
author: David Christopher Kaufman
content:
![How the Black-Jewish Alliance Broke
Up](https://www.compactmag.com/content/images/2026/02/PHOTO-2026-02-09-23-00-25-2-1-1-1.jpg)

The most controversial
[_commercial_](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kfKuf4aVHxU&ref=compactmag.com)
aired during this year's Super Bowl was a segment paid for by Patriots owner
Robert Kraft. The ad featured a black student defending a Jewish classmate
from anti-semitic harassment by white classmates. The ad, which
[_reportedly_](https://www.thejc.com/news/usa/super-bowl-2026-robert-kraft-ad-
antisemitism-iosehuwj?ref=compactmag.com) cost $15 million to produce, was
intended to spotlight rising Jew-hatred in America while building "allyship"
between African-Americans and Jewish-Americans. Instead, the commercial was
widely bashed by [_critics_](https://forward.com/fast-forward/803848/super-
bowl-antisemitism-ad-backlash-kraft/?ref=compactmag.com) as "dated" and
"disconnected" for [_stereotyping_](https://thecjn.ca/news/robert-krafts-
sticky-note-super-bowl-ad-lands-as-combat-antisemitism-consensus-
shatters/?ref=compactmag.com) its Jewish protagonist as weak.

> "The commercial was widely bashed by critics as 'dated' and 'disconnected.'"

The ad was just one of a number of recent calls for renewed unity between
African-Americans and Jewish-Americans. As anti-Jewish hate crimes now[
_outnumber_](https://www.timesofisrael.com/nyc-jews-targeted-in-hate-crimes-
more-than-all-other-groups-combined-in-2025-nypd/?ref=compactmag.com) those of
every other minority group combined in [_major American
cities_](https://www.bostonglobe.com/2026/01/16/metro/massachusetts-hate-
crime-antisemitism-most-
common/?ref=compactmag.com#:~:text=Antisemitic%20incidents%20surge%20to%20become,reports%20police%20take%20in%20Massachusetts.),
activists in both communities are leaning into the "historic alliances"
between blacks and Jews to counter the anti-semitism surge.

A new four-part[ _PBS series_](https://www.pbs.org/show/black-and-jewish-
america-an-interwoven-history/?ref=compactmag.com), _Black and Jewish America:
An Interwoven History_ , for instance, debuted on February 3, hosted by Henry
Louis Gates Jr. and featuring notable thinkers highlighting past community
victories along with solutions to current vexations. The show follows a high-
profile panel in January at New York City's [_92nd Street
Y_](https://www.92ny.org/event/bridging-the-divide?ref=compactmag.com) focused
on forming new black-Jewish alliances--along with [_forums,
dinners_](https://forward.com/news/798357/black-jewish-alliances-van-jones-
exodus-rekindle/?ref=compactmag.com), and other[ _cross-cultural
initiatives_](https://zioness.org/zahav-fellowship/?ref=compactmag.com) __
aimed at reminding blacks and Jews how deep their shared histories flow.
